name: Native local correspondence before region pooling
source_observations: all original 1107 legal frames and all original masks; no extra caps
teachers: existing native SigLIP and DINOv2-base; no language-role parser
patch_storage: all raw patch descriptors and sparse region-to-patch area weights; declared high-capacity control, not compact
bidirectional_match: mean query-to-region and area-weighted region-to-query nearest cosine
reciprocal_match: mutual nearest-neighbor pairs; sum sqrt(query mass * region mass) times shifted cosine
query_access: map only; image query owns its crop; points have no RGB/depth/SAM
parameter_search: fixed two local matching alternatives, no fitted thresholds or coefficient sweep
public_benchmarks: same complete common recipe and original contracts, no gains claimed without execution
decision: Bidirectional local matching promoted in system_v8 after all 31 common jobs; pooled and reciprocal remain controls.
